A sub-sample is an S13 Sample in its own right, using the identical field set to Sample. It has NO Sampling Site of its own - its link to the Painting is derived by walking O29i/O27 back to the root Sample, then O5i/O3 to that Sample's Sampling Site.

S24 Sample Splitting, a subclass of S2 Sample Taking. O27 split is a subproperty of O3 sampled from; O29 removed sub-sample is a subproperty of O5 removed. Deliberately does NOT carry O3 to the Painting or Sampling Site - O3 implies O1 diminished, which would falsely record the painting being diminished again.
